title: Europe "scrambles" to find a united voice over Middle East conflict
summary: As the conflict in the Middle East expands, European countries are struggling to find a united voice. EU Commission President Ursula von der Leyen has said that the only lasting solution in Iran is a diplomatic one, while Spain's Prime Minister Pedro Sanchez has been the only one to outright condemn the US strikes. FRANCE 24's Douglas Herbert tells us more.
